caveats: Shared virtual runner with concurrent agents; initial benchmark overlapped build/tests. These are raw exploratory measurements, not a controlled speedup claim.
loadedBytes and indexedBytes are explicit admission costs, not measured process heap or RSS.
Before/after eager-index samples and current deferred-index samples are separate modes. Browser page expansion excludes already-completed cooperative indexing.

Actual SolutionExplorer 20000-file initial rendering was one measured sample (0.8 ms, one node), not a median or controlled speedup claim. Its first page was 2.9 ms after index preparation, 104 model nodes and 32 DOM rows. The separate seven-run 10000-file page fixture measured median 1.2 ms and p95 1.5 ms.

actions.disk-external-change: {path,record,event,expectedVersion}; root validates version then atomically adopts record/delete/rename and updates physical hashes without dirtying source
actions.disk-reevaluate: {path,event,record} or {path,event,rescan:true,records,folders,report}; root overlays current dirty records and reevaluates project membership

integrationContract.findInFiles: await disk.findInFiles(query,{matchCase,wholeWord,maxMatches,signal}); returns the LanguageService response shape
integrationContract.save: Await physical-directory persistence identity; inject disk.saveLocks or resolveSaveLocks. Browser save otherwise reports Unavailable; there is no workspace-name fallback.
integrationContract.adoptRecords: disk.adoptRecords(records,{folders,report,preserveBaselines:true}); caller sets committed new path hashes after adoption.
integrationContract.legacyAPI: DiskWorkspace/readDirectory/readBrowserFiles keep prior defaults; the protected host migrates aliases explicitly with its lifecycle hooks.
integrationContract.reevaluationAcknowledgment: Return {reevaluated:true} after atomic host application to avoid a second XML evaluation.

issues.title: [SF-A24-T17] Add overlay provider for unsaved buffers and generated files

Generated documents reject mutation and dirty buffers survive base conflicts.
Delayed read/hash work checks entry identity and publication generation before admitting bytes; discard, disposal, newer buffers and quota races cannot publish stale content.
Completed physical saves preserve newer dirty buffers and update their baseline; delayed rename/delete operations preserve concurrent edits.

Held ownership signals reach actual baseline reads and writes; save versions survive load/save/unload/load, and exhausted versions reject before physical writes.

issues.title: [SF-A24-T05.1] Remove fixed document ceilings with lazily loaded documents
testedAcceptance: Registering 5000 closed files reads no contents. Loaded records are admitted by byte budget and dirty/pinned buffers are not evicted.
Workspace can subscribe to eviction without replacing the embedding host callback; closed records remain explicit lazy metadata.
Actual Workspace opens and parses only requested files; compileAsync admits only records selected for compilation. Metadata APIs reject embedded contents outside the admission budget.
Delayed disk reads cannot restore entries deleted, renamed, refreshed or replaced while loading; unrelated entry changes remain valid and concurrent admission rechecks the final byte budget.
Bulk metadata admission after document-store disposal rejects without repopulating entries.
Final synchronous beforeAdmit guards reject without partial publication; load/unload preserve monotonic watermarks, with actual editor lifecycle and physical transaction regressions.

issues.title: [SF-A24-T05.5] Add path and text search index for large workspaces
